name: Government Vidyaniketan Scholarship.
description: Sanction Set 80 (For Government vidhyaniketan,Pusegaon Amravati Aurangabad Dhule 20 students from each) Students passed Xth Class from Govt Vidhyaniketan are eligible for this schoalrship. For new sanction students must have 60% marks in Xth Class. New sanction process done through DHE office and Renewal sanction process done through joint director office of concern colleges. Selection of Candidates Is on Merit basis

criteria.label: Need to get 60% marks in 10th standard.
